notes.title: Patch v1.0.1.5
notes.content:
- [x] There is now a unique in-game mouse cursor that can be toggled on in settings, which may be easier to keep track of if you wish to use it.
- [x] Your mouse cursor can now be locked to the window via a toggle in settings.
- [x] When using a controller in-game, the virtual cursor should now be locked to your screen.
- [x] Bug fix: NPCs should no longer give you the silent treatment when trying to hand in quests or talk to them.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1.4
notes.content: Bug fix - Sometimes collectors would get distracted while trying to return coal to the stockpile when you blew the collector whistle. Those collectors have been dealt with.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1.3
notes.content: Collectors should no longer randomly run away and never return.

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1.2
notes.content:
Minor bug fix: Fixed keybinds remapping bug not saving between sessions for some keys.

(Please note the game will still say v1.0.1 in-game once patched.)

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1 - explosive update
notes.content:
- [x] Vacuum cleaner now lets you directly deposit via it by interacting with it (Default Key E)
- [x] Mortar guns received a significant boost in their damage, with two new tiers of mortar guns now available.
- [x] Bombs received a decent buff to their damage, with a new tier of bombs for the red layer now available.

Bugs
- [x] Fixed broken unlock professions achievements
- [x] Attempted to fix a bug with the tile map that is causing some users' games to crash.
- [x] Next item and previous item now correctly saves your choices when remapping the key binds.

notes.title: v1.0.0.12
notes.content:
- [x] Added an auto-sprint toggle in settings under the “Controls” tab. So you can automatically sprint and hold shift to walk.

- [x] Various bug fixes.

notes.title: v1.0.0.11
notes.content: Fixed bug where the destructor class accidentally picked up items into their inventory from chests.

notes.title: v1.0.0.10 patch notes
notes.content: Changed Keybind for dropping items to CTRL + Left Click, instead of Shift + Left Click. This is to prevent the player from accidentally dropping items while they are sprinting and using their items.

notes.title: v1.0.0.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- [x] Added one-click looting chests upgrade (no longer need to chase falling items when collecting chests!)
- [x] Added option for a random amount of cash from passive effect scrolls

notes.title: Patch v1.0.0.8 - Small Achievement Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Small Bug Fixes

- [x] Unlock map achievements should now work properly (and should be applied retroactively when you reach the map selection screen.)
- [x] Achievements that should not be given in peaceful mode are no longer being given in peaceful mode!

notes.title: Coal LLC Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
Coal LLC will be coming to you on the 12th of September 2025!
The new gameplay trailer hints at just some of the new content coming to the full game. Take a look now on the Steam page.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.8.1
notes.content:
Patch to add-in windowed mode toggle. 

You should now be able to toggle windowed/full screen mode by either:


Pressing Alt + Enter anywhere
Pressing F11 anywhere
Pressing Toggle Full Screen button in the Settings Menu


Your preferred mode will be saved between sessions.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.7.1
notes.content:
Patch v0.2.7.1 is out, some rebalancing:

    
 Shoddy and Copper guns are now automatically unlocked.
     Level 1 Chests contain Amethysts instead of rubies, and up to emerald gun unlocks
     Level 2 Chests contain rubies instead of diamonds, and up to amethyst gun unlocks.
     Level 3 Chests contain diamonds instead of pink diamonds, and up to ruby gun unlocks.
     Level 4 Chests contain pink diamonds and no golden minigun powerups.

notes.title: v0.2.6.3 Demo Patch
notes.content:
Patch v0.2.6.3 for the demo is out:

    [x] Added silver, amethyst, gold and ruby guns
    [x] Rebalanced gun rarity system in chests. Made it more defined, that the deeper you go the better the gun unlocks.
    [x] Winning a game now auto-unlocks the barbarian profession (unfortunately not retroactively applied)
    [x] Platforms/ladders now have a small buffer to stop double placements when trying to place only one
    [x] Reduced timer on miners being "stuck" before they try to fix themselves.
    [x] Just press down instead of down + jump for platforms.
    [x] Jump buffer fiddled with to be less clunky (now only buffers a jump if spacebar has just been pressed down, before it would buffer a jump if spacebar is being held pressed down.)

Happy Mining!

- Bye Bye Ocean

notes.title: Coal LLC has just had a MAJOR DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
Today, we have released the next phase of Coal LLC. After all of your interest and excitement around the initial demo, we've worked hard to bring you a bigger, better and more performant demo. There are too many changes to list them all, but here are some of them:


 We've significantly improved a good chunk of the major lag-inducing parts of the game. Most machines shouldn't encounter lag anymore in normal gameplay!
 New weapons to mine coal with! The demo includes emerald pistols, shotguns and assault rifles to blast away the coal. Also you may just find a Golden Mini-gun power-up...
 A second Barbarian profession to unlock and play, giving you AOE strikes but limiting your other options...
 Much shorter days!
 And so much more to uncover...!


Happy coal mining!

- Bye Bye Ocean
